name: infrared_benchmark
description: A Hugging Face dataset for evaluating computer vision models on infrared/thermal imagery. It provides labeled infrared images intended to test model robustness in low-light and thermal sensing scenarios (e.g., classification and detection tasks). Useful for assessing real-world performance of vision systems that rely on infrared sensors.
reputation: Niche Hugging Face dataset with limited community adoption; primarily used for specialized infrared/thermal vision experiments.
